mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_backtest_run (id, tenant_id, owner_id, strategy_version_id, requested_as_of_date, actual_as_of_date, status, config, benchmark, data_source, warnings, summary, started_at, completed_at) values (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{ownerId}, #{strategyVersionId}, #{requestedAsOfDate}, #{actualAsOfDate}, #{status}, cast(#{config} as jsonb), #{benchmark}, #{dataSource}, cast(#{warnings} as jsonb), cast(#{summary} as jsonb), #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})

insert into cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_backtest_trade (id, backtest_run_id, signal_date, entry_date, exit_date, market, stock_code, stock_name, signal_rank, score, entry_price, exit_price, gross_return_pct, net_return_pct, benchmark_return_pct, excess_return_pct, outcome) values (#{id}, #{backtestRunId}, #{signalDate}, #{entryDate}, #{exitDate}, #{market}, #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{signalRank}, #{score}, #{entryPrice}, #{exitPrice}, #{grossReturnPct}, #{netReturnPct}, #{benchmarkReturnPct}, #{excessReturnPct}, #{outcome})
mapper.select: select id, tenant_id as tenantId, owner_id as ownerId from cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_backtest_run where status = 'QUEUED' order by created_at asc for update skip locked limit 1

select r.id, r.tenant_id as tenantId, r.owner_id as ownerId, r.strategy_version_id as strategyVersionId, d.strategy_code as strategyCode, v.version_no as strategyVersionNo, r.requested_as_of_date as requestedAsOfDate, r.actual_as_of_date as actualAsOfDate, r.status, r.config, r.benchmark, r.data_source as dataSource, r.warnings, r.summary, r.started_at as startedAt, r.completed_at as completedAt from cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_backtest_run r join cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_version v on v.id=r.strategy_version_id join cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_definition d on d.id=v.strategy_definition_id where r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and r.owner_id=#{ownerId} and d.strategy_code=#{strategyCode} and r.status='SUCCEEDED' and v.deleted_at is null and d.deleted_at is null order by r.completed_at desc nulls last, r.created_at desc limit 1
mapper.update: update cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_backtest_run set status = 'RUNNING' where id = #{id} and status = 'QUEUED'

update cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_backtest_run set actual_as_of_date = #{actualAsOfDate}, status = #{status}, warnings = cast(#{warnings} as jsonb), summary = cast(#{summary} as jsonb), completed_at = #{completedAt} where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and owner_id = #{ownerId} and status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: select r.id, r.tenant_id as tenantId, r.owner_id as ownerId, r.strategy_version_id as strategyVersionId, d.strategy_code as strategyCode, v.version_no as strategyVersionNo, r.requested_as_of_date as requestedAsOfDate, r.actual_as_of_date as actualAsOfDate, r.status, r.config, r.benchmark, r.data_source as dataSource, r.warnings, r.summary, r.started_at as startedAt, r.completed_at as completedAt from cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_backtest_run r join cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_version v on v.id=r.strategy_version_id join cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_definition d on d.id=v.strategy_definition_id where r.id=#{id} and r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and r.owner_id=#{ownerId}

select id, backtest_run_id as backtestRunId, signal_date as signalDate, entry_date as entryDate, exit_date as exitDate, market, stock_code as stockCode, stock_name as stockName, signal_rank as signalRank, score, entry_price as entryPrice, exit_price as exitPrice, gross_return_pct as grossReturnPct, net_return_pct as netReturnPct, benchmark_return_pct as benchmarkReturnPct, excess_return_pct as excessReturnPct, outcome from cynexus_appl_market.stock_selection_strategy_backtest_trade where backtest_run_id=#{runId} order by signal_date, signal_rank
